description: This file provides UI/UX enhancements for Olivero theme settings in Drupal, including creating synchronized color input elements, handling color schemes, and initializing color pickers with accessibility features.

methods.name: announceFieldChange
methods.description: Announces the change of a form field's label and value for accessibility.

methods.name: formatHex
methods.description: Formats a hex color code to a full 6-character string with a leading '#'.

methods.name: synchronizeInputs
methods.description: Keeps text and color inputs in sync and updates the color scheme selector.

methods.name: setColorScheme
methods.description: Sets individual color inputs based on a selected color scheme.

methods.name: initColorSchemeSelect
methods.description: Initializes the color scheme select element and sets its value based on current colors.

methods.name: initColorPicker
methods.description: Creates a color input element, inserts it after a text input, and synchronizes their values.
